findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract, render, screenshot, pdf, links, meta, guard, maps, unblock, amazon, extract-structured, sms_number, sms_inbox · Private data: pdf, fr_score-entreprise_partial, fr_kyb, fr_verif-artisan, uk_company, uk_psc, us_company, us_financials, us_filings, fr_enrich, llm, llm_pro, sms_number · Public sink: extract, render, screenshot, pdf, links, meta, guard, fr_bilans, sms_number, sms_inbox · Destructive: transcribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract, render, screenshot, pdf, links, meta, guard, maps, unblock, amazon, extract-structured, sms_number, sms_inbox · Private data: pdf, fr_score-entreprise_partial, fr_kyb, fr_verif-artisan, uk_company, uk_psc, us_company, us_financials, us_filings, fr_enrich, llm, llm_pro, sms_number · Public sink: extract, render, screenshot, pdf, links, meta, guard, fr_bilans, sms_number, sms_inbox · Destructive: transcribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
